title.narrative: UN DOALOS Travel support for partcipation in meetings of the BBNJ Preparatory Commission

description.narrative:
Travel support to delegates from the least developed countries, land-locked developing countries and small island developing States, participating in the meetings of the Preparatory Commission to prepare for the entry into force of the Agreement under the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea on the Conservation and Sustainable Use of Marine Biological Diversity of Areas beyond National Jurisdiction (BBNJ Preparatory Commission). The participation will allow delegates to take part in the global efforts, interact with partners, and explore possibilities for cooperation, including at the regional level.
The UNDOALOS project (UN Office of Legal Affairs – Division for Ocean Affairs and the Law of the Sea), funded by Norway (through Norad), is part of Norway’s support for sustainable management of nature and climate — specifically focused on the oceans and sustainable ocean governance. UNDOALOS assist developing countries in building legal and institutional capacity to govern their ocean spaces effectively. This includes assisting states to implement the UN Convention on the Law of the Sea (UNCLOS) and other international agreements that govern marine resources, maritime boundaries, shipping, and ocean conservation. Norway’s funded UNDOALOS project helps developing countries improve how they govern and manage their marine resources and ocean spaces, which in turn supports sustainable ocean use, climate resilience, and stronger environmental stewardship.
